\[

1 & -2 & 1 \\ 
1 & -2 & 9 \\

\end{pmatrix}
\]

Next, we calculate the determinant of \(\mathbf{AB}\) using cofactor expansion along the first row:

\[
\det(\mathbf{AB}) = 1 \cdot \det\begin{pmatrix} -2 & 9 \\ 3 & 3 \end{pmatrix} - (-2) \cdot \det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 9 \\ 5 & 3 \end{pmatrix} + 1 \cdot \det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ 5 & 3 \end{pmatrix}

\[

\]

First, we compute the product \(\mathbf{AB}\):

\[
\mathbf{AB} = \begin{pmatrix} 
1 & -2 & 1 \\ 
1 & -2 & 9 \\ 
5 & 3 & 3 
\end{pmatrix}
\]

Next, we calculate the determinant of \(\mathbf{AB}\) using cofactor expansion along the first row:

\[
\det(\mathbf{AB}) = 1 \cdot \det\begin{pmatrix} -2 & 9 \\ 3 & 3 \end{pmatrix} - (-2) \cdot \det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 9 \\ 5 & 3 \end{pmatrix} + 1 \cdot \det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ 5 & 3 \end{pmatrix}
\]

- \(\det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 9 \\ 5 & 3 \end{pmatrix} = 1(3) - 9(5) = 3 - 45 = -42\)
- \(\det\begin{pmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ 5 & 3 \end{pmatrix} = 1(3) - (-2)(5) = 3 + 10 = 13\)

\[

\]
